headline: Insurance Companies' Profits Grow Thinner, OJK Reveals This Fact
summary: The Financial Services Authority said the insurance industry faces pressure as return on equity declined to 12.7%. It sees room for improvement.
why: Return on equity measures profitability relative to shareholder capital, a key metric for insurers and their investors.
original_headline: Untung Perusahaan Asuransi Makin Tipis, OJK Ungkap Fakta Ini
